people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.
translations.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
translations.asv: Jesus therefore perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again into the mountain himself alone.
